newsitem.title: USA: Lockheed Martin unit wins radar contract.
newsitem.headline: Lockheed Martin unit wins radar contract.

text.p: Lockheed Martin Ocean, Radar & Sensor Systems said on Thursday that it had received a multi-million dollar contract from Raytheon Co for six tactical mobile radars.
Lockheed did not specify a dollar amount for the contract, but said it involved future options.

The radars are designated for Brazil's "System for the Vigilance of the Amazon" project, a surveillance project over the Amazon region that includes environmental monitoring, air traffic control and communications networks, Lockheed said in a statement.
The U.S. Export-Import Bank is providing the majority of the financing for SIVAM, it added.
Lockheed Martin Ocean, Radar & Sensor Systems is an operating unit of Lockheed Martin Electronics Sector, a unit of aerospace and information giant Lockheed Martin Corp.
